about: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited is a technology-led B2B manufacturing platform. It combines third-party suppliers with owned manufacturing plants to produce industrial and consumer products, while Terra91 supplies industrial raw materials. The group serves energy, electronics, capital goods, aerospace and defence customers in India and overseas. [1]
